activity.notes: Oscar II was King of both Sweden and Norway from 1872 until the dissolution of the union in 1905. ATLAS uses the composite polity Sweden–Norway specifically for the shared-monarch union phase requested here, ending on 26 October 1905 when Oscar formally renounced the Norwegian crown. His continued Swedish reign to 1907 is not duplicated as a second Activity in this registration.

sources.title: Oskar II — The Royal Court of Sweden
sources.citation_text: The Royal Court identifies Oskar II as king from 1872 to 1907 and specifically as king of the Swedish-Norwegian Union until its dissolution in 1905.

sources.title: Oscar 2. — Store norske leksikon
sources.citation_text: Store norske leksikon identifies Oscar II as King of Sweden 1872–1907 and King of Norway 1872–1905, the last union king.

sources.title: Unionsoppløsningen i 1905 — Store norske leksikon
sources.citation_text: The union dissolution chronology records Oscar II's formal renunciation of the Norwegian crown on 26 October 1905.
